author: CC
prose: The orchestrator split (A) into A1 (a merge runs the commit door, db250e9bf3f9) and A2, the lab-twin tooth, depends_on A1: "The order is not a question for Akien; it's mechanism. Commons lands first, and A2's refusal message says so: \"land the commons lab copy <name> first\"." The finding behind it: a cairn commit that changes an intention+why.json has no lab twin in CairnCommons/intentions-congruency-lab unless the lander recompiles and commits the commons by hand; 77 of 304 charter writes since 10-16 left the lab stale.
